description: Ordered MASM-derived opening demo flow for the Zeliard web port. This is the checklist for oracle capture and C/WASM parity work.

notes: game.asm loads zelres1 ch1 opdemo.bin at CS:6000 and jumps through loaded_code_b.
MASM is the source of truth for ordering, assets, palette calls, waits, transitions, and script breaks.
Visible sequence must be verified by oracle checkpoints before additional C behavior changes are accepted.

input_rules.timer_wait_loop: SPACE or ENTER jumps to opening_next_scene during the pre/post-title wait loops.
input_rules.story_scene_input_handler: SPACE or ENTER jumps to transition_out_to_game during post-title story scenes.

phases.visible_summary: Copyright text appears first, then the Zeliard title image fades in; after a short hold the card clears without an exit fade.
transitions: copyright text appears on black before the title image is visible
title image fades in from black after the copyright text is already present
scene_data_a is drawn through narration_stone_disp_fn
ttl3.grp is blitted through disp_narr_chap3_slot
title card clears without a visible exit fade before the necklace/amulet prologue
script_or_text: Copyright (C)1987,1990 GAME ARTS
Copyright (C)1990 Sierra On-Line

phases.visible_summary: Necklace/amulet image fades in, the ancient-history text scrolls upward over it, then text and image fade out.
transitions: necklace/amulet image fades in before text starts scrolling
animate_scanline uses the text stream near runtime 6FF0
SPACE or ENTER during this scroll advances to staff_credits_scroll
text and image fade out when the scroll completes or is skipped
script_or_text: Two thousand years, from the dark reaches of another galaxy...
The King of Felishika...
The Tears of Esmesanti...
The Age of Darkness.

phases.visible_summary: Isolated NEC/HOU service contract retained for oracle coverage; not inserted into the first seven visible playback steps.
transitions: gfx_draw_fn draws NEC region
animate_scanline runs interlace/scanline transition
HOU overlay is decompressed to screen_buf_2 and drawn through disp_game_fn_slot

phases.visible_summary: Isolated demon service contract retained for oracle coverage; not inserted into the first seven visible playback steps.
transitions: palette_lookup prepares sprite buffers
scene_sprite_c drives repeated disp_narr_chap2 calls
scene_sprite_b drives play_sprite_anim_script
jashiin_speech_disp_fn clears or draws speech area
script_or_text: Jashiin/demon pre-title animated speech data

phases.visible_summary: Isolated title-logo/music/color-rotation service contract retained for oracle coverage; not inserted into the first seven visible playback steps.
transitions: jashiin_speech_disp_fn clears the speech area
ttl1.grp is decoded into scene_framebuf
ttl2.grp is loaded into vga_seg
ttl3.grp is loaded into aux_buf_seg and decoded after the first long wait
zopn.msd is loaded and started through int 60h
scene_color_rotate_loop performs 64h iterations before opening_next_scene
script_or_text: title logo display handoff and color rotation

transitions: gfx_mode_fn sets the full-screen credits mode
credits_scroll_display uses anim_fn_wipe_slot, anim_fn_fade_slot, and anim_fn_draw_slot
SPACE or ENTER during credits advances to rain_princess_story_start
credits finish/fade before trans_exit

phases.visible_summary: Rain begins over Zeliard; Princess Felicia watches from the balcony.
transitions: waku is decompressed to ES:2000 overlay plane
ame is decompressed to scene_framebuf
BLIT_SCENE_FRAME draws the framed rain scene
run_script_interpreter advances through the storm narration
script_or_text: Once, long ago, a terrible storm came to the land of Zeliard.
On the seventh day of rain...
The girl was Princess Felicia la Felishika.
What a dreadful storm! Will it never end?

phases.visible_summary: The rain changes into sand and the kingdom becomes desert.
transitions: font area is cleared with disp_font_inv_slot
dmaou.grp is decompressed to scene_data_i
busy_wait_delay and apply_palette_blend create the transformation effect
script_or_text: Just as the princess spoke these words, the raindrops turned to grains of sand...
As she watched, a startling transformation began...
This ever-green land was turning to desert before her very eyes.

phases.visible_summary: Jashiin speaks, threatens Felishika, and Princess Felicia is turned to stone.
transitions: script speaker/color controls switch to Jashiin text
portrait/speech rendering uses 80h-9Fh script controls where present
stone narration uses shared text renderer and story script breaks
script_or_text: I am Jashiin, the Emperor of Chaos.
Beautiful Princess Felicia...
Princess Felicia was turned to stone.

phases.visible_summary: After 108 days of sand, the King grieves and the Guardian Spirit appears.
transitions: overlay region at BX=1728h CX=2230h is redrawn through disp_data_7420_slot and disp_game_fn_slot
wait_story_scene_timer gates the apparition timing
script_or_text: The rain of sand continued for 108 days...
The King wept most of all.
But the tears of the King and his people soon awakened another power.
I am the Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard.

phases.visible_summary: The Spirit vanishes and Duke Garland arrives in the kingdom.
transitions: isi.grp is displayed before Duke's arrival text
oui.grp replaces scene_framebuf for castle/throne approach
script_or_text: Having spoken these words, the Spirit disappeared.
But the next day, a stranger appeared in the kingdom...
What a desolate place! Why has the Spirit led me here?
Entering the castle, he was quickly escorted to the throne...

phases.visible_summary: King Felishika begs Duke Garland for help, and Duke accepts the quest.
transitions: sei.grp is drawn to scene_framebuf with disp_data_7420_slot
animated text bytes ANIM_80-ANIM_9F are interleaved with King and Duke speech
script_or_text: Duke Garland! You must be the man of destiny...
Duke Garland knelt before the King.
Your Majesty, I have followed the light of the Spirit...
I will dedicate my life to this task.
May God go with you on your quest.

phases.visible_summary: Black mist forms; Jashiin and Duke Garland confront each other.
transitions: yuup.grp and oup.grp are drawn as paired regions
maop.grp is drawn through disp_script_area
vertical reveal loops adjust BX/DX over 18h iterations
script_or_text: Suddenly, the room grew cold.
Are you the fool who dares to challenge me?
And you must be the evil Jashiin!
You shall address me as the Emperor of Chaos...
Mark my words, evil one...

phases.visible_summary: Jashiin threatens Duke, disappears, and Duke vows that Jashiin's reign is near its end.
transitions: yuu2.grp is drawn for final narration
yuu3.grp and yuu4.grp are merged with merge_gfx_planes and xor_mask_render
Jashiin departing threat is embedded after the dual-use dispatch/text table
script_or_text: The demon laughed...
Jashiin disappeared leaving echoes of earsplitting laughter.
You haven't seen the last of me, Jashiin!
Beware, for I shall wake from my sleep of 2,000 years...

phases.visible_summary: Final narration asks whether Duke Garland will dethrone the Emperor of Chaos.
transitions: animate_scanline_alt performs the final scanline/fade transition
ten long wait frames follow before transition_out_to_game
script_or_text: At last, the door of destiny was opened.
The labyrinths are deep, and the way is long.
Will Duke Garland be successful in dethroning the Emperor of Chaos?

phases.visible_summary: Opening demo exits and game.bin is loaded for actual gameplay.
transitions: gfx_mode_fn resets mode
input flags are cleared
sar_loader_fn loads game.bin with AL=3
jump through exit_jmp_target_ptr enters gameplay
